text_helper: Table 59. WWDG min/max timeout value @72 MHz (PCLK) — section 6.3.16 Timer characteristics. Prescaler, WDGTB, Min timeout value, Max timeout value.

notes: 1. These timings are given for a 40 kHz clock but the microcontroller internal RC frequency can vary from 30 to 50 kHz. Moreover, given an exact RC oscillator frequency, the exact timings still depend on the phasing
2. Spikes with widths below t are filtered. AF(min)
3. Spikes with widths above t are not filtered AF(max)
